buildCommand: ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && pnpm --filter @workspace/awrms run build && APP="$(pnpm --filter @workspace/awrms exec pwd)" && rm -rf "$ROOT/public" "$APP/public" && mkdir -p "$ROOT/public" && cp -R "$APP/dist/public/." "$ROOT/public/" && if [ "$ROOT" != "$APP" ]; then mkdir -p "$APP/public" && cp -R "$APP/dist/public/." "$APP/public/"; fi
